falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A volatility spike this severe would suggest a blowoff top is occurring, directly contradicting the current HOLD and UNKNOWN status.

falsification_conditions.condition: The Relative Strength Index (RSI) shows a bearish divergence (price makes a new high while RSI fails to) with a 10% RSI low within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This divergence would indicate weakening momentum and potential reversal, falsifying the HOLD signal and UNKNOWN verdict by proving a directional bias exists.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
